0.original: The swarthy Resistance fighter is at wit's end.

24.original: Search for the swarthy Resistance fighter's ward.

25.original: Deliver the ward to the swarthy Resistance fighter.

48.original: Damn it all! Where could it have got to!?

49.original: Oh! Um, pardon me, fellow lover of freedom and justice. You haven't seen a ward of the Destroyer anywhere, have you? Maybe on the ground, as if a certain bloody fool had dropped it?

50.original: Aye, I'd been him. I had it this morning, that much I know for certain, and I've not left the Reach since, so it's got to be around here somewhere.

51.original: Hmm... If you've got a moment to spare, would you be willing to help me search? I spent some time near the Temple of the Fist earlier, so it might be there. As for me, I'll look around near the officer's pavilion.

52.original: They're hardly rare, I know, and I could just as easily buy another, but even so... Please, help me find it...

53.original: If it's not here, then it's got to be somewhere near the Temple of the Fist. At least, I think it's got to be one of these two locations...

54.original: I swear, I've searched high and low, but it just won't turn up...

55.original: Seven hells, that's the one! That's my lucky ward! You're a godssend, <hex:020814E905FF07736973746572FF0862726F7468657203>!

56.original: Before I was born, my mother made a pilgrimage to the Temple of the Fist, where she, like many others, received the blessings of the monks.

57.original: And then Theodoric came and burned it all to the ground, the mad bastard. And after him came the Garleans, who cared even less for our beliefs.

58.original: But I still keep to the old ways, as do many others. And when my son is born, I'll teach him the stories and the scripture, as my mother taught me...

59.original: Assisting one of your fellow freedom fighters? I will leave you to it, then.
